en: A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a historic building with a domed roof and a slender Ottoman‑style minaret rising above it, crowned by a crescent. In front of the structure are bare trees and an iron fence. At the bottom margin of the image, handwritten-style text identifies the location. The reverse side is blank, laid out in the classic divided‑back postcard style with printed publisher information along the right edge.
